why: Two halves of one authoring surface: the option shapes describe what the builders accept, and `PipelineEntry` (and the nested pipeline options built on it) is defined by `StepBuilder`. Splitting the pair would move the cycle, not remove it; merging them would make one unreadable file.

Genuine recursion: a child pipeline runs the same step loop as its parent, and the loop is what executes an orchestration node. The shapes the two exchange already live apart in `pipeline-orchestration-types.ts`; what is left is the call itself. A pass reaches that node through step-pass, on its own or inside a group, so this one recursion is seen on both edges that enter step-pass.
